meta.title: 6 lessons people learn far too late in life

plates.query: Caspar David Friedrich figure at evening looking back painting
Hudson River School long road behind a traveller painting
Rembrandt old wise face in warm light painting

beats.text: Six lessons almost everyone learns too late.
One. Your health is the wealth everything else is built on. Spend it carefully.
Two. Most of what you worried about never actually happened. The dread was the only real cost.
Three. In the end it's the people, not the achievements, that you replay.
Four. Comparison quietly steals every joy it touches. Run your own race.
Five. Every 'yes' to the wrong thing is a 'no' to something that mattered more.
Six. You become what you repeatedly do — not what you keep meaning to do.
You don't have to learn these the slow way. You just read them. Now live like you know.
